subject: Post-demo: Decision pathway, security + contract touchpoints
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@betacorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@betacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed decision pathway and asks

Hi Anna / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary (2 min)
- Demo covered inference latency and cost controls, private deployment options, and our rollout/rollbacks.
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization at 10k qps equivalent, with PII filtering in the pipeline.

Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (VP Product) — controls budget and procurement timeline.
- Security owner: Anna Lopez (Head of Security) — needs SOC2 evidence + network architecture.
- Procurement: procurement@betacorp.com — standard SOW/PO process.
- Engineering champion: Javier (your team) — will validate integration and perf.

Immediate asks / proposed timeline
1) Security: Anna, can you confirm the two highest-priority artifacts you need (SOC2, pen-test report, or network diagrams)? We can provide SOC2 summary + selective logs within 2 business days and network diagram this week.
2) Procurement: Tom/Procurement, what’s your typical procurement window for a SaaS + Dedicated GPU reserved capacity? If helpful, we can share a draft commercial term sheet.
3) Pilot: propose 8-week pilot with a capped spend. If acceptable, we’ll provide a pilot pricing estimate by Wed.

Attachments: pricing-estimate.pdf (summary estimate)

Next meeting: propose 4/22 at 10:00am PT for PRD+procurement alignment; happy to adjust.

Thanks — I’ll assemble a one-pager that maps decision owners to checkpoints and circulate.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@betacorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@betacorp.com>
Cc: BetaCorp Procurement <procurement@betacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed decision pathway and asks

Thanks Jasmine — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement window: for a vendor we’ve not previously purchased dedicated infra from, plan ~6 weeks for legal + PO, assuming standard terms. If we need SC/SSRs or an MSA redline, that may add another 1–2 weeks.
- Security artifacts: Anna, we need SOC2 Type II report (or summary + auditor letter), a whiteboard-level network diagram, and answers to these three questions: can Redwood support customer-managed KMS, what are log retention options, and is there an on-prem option?

Anna — I’m looping procurement so they can flag any mandatory clauses (data residency, export controls). Procurement, can you confirm the PO template and whether a pilot requires a PO or an internal spend authorization?

On timing — 4/22 10am PT works for me.

Best,
Tom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: BetaCorp Procurement <procurement@betacorp.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@betacorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@betacorp.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: draft commercial terms & security evidence — for procurement/legal review

Hi team — circling in on the procurement thread. I’m Marissa (Customer Success) — assigned to run the pilot and coordinate procurement/legal. Attaching a first-pass redline for the pilot SOW we typically use; it includes:
- Pilot duration and exit criteria (8 weeks, integration and latency checks)
- Data handling: customer-owned keys (KMS) option, and limited log export for troubleshooting
- Liability caps scoped to pilot spend

Attachment: redlines_draft.docx (pilot SOW with comments)

Responses to Anna’s security questions (preliminary):
- Customer-managed KMS: supported in Private deployments and VPC mode; hosted uses KMS integrations — we can surface configuration docs.
- Log retention: configurable; default 30 days, 90/365 available for enterprise add-on.
- On-prem option: yes — we support an on-prem deployment package for regulated workloads; that typically requires an onsite ops engagement (SOW).

Procurement — layout below is our suggested path to keep the pilot on a 6-week track:
1) Review and confirm any mandatory clauses (data residency/export controls) — by 4/23 EOD
2) Legal redline on the attached SOW — by 4/27
3) PO or internal spend sign-off — by 5/3

If helpful I can set a separate call for procurement/legal only; otherwise we’ll address on Friday 4/22 meeting.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@betacorp.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@betacorp.com>, BetaCorp Procurement <procurement@betacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: 4/22 meeting — agenda + deliverables (final)

Morning all — quick note ahead of today’s 10am PT call. Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Alignment on decision owners + acceptance criteria (Tom / Anna)
- 10m: Security artifacts & timeline (Anna + Marissa)
- 10m: Procurement path and PO checklist (Procurement rep)
- 5m: Pilot kickoff steps and immediate deliverables

Deliverables we’ll bring to the call
- Redwood: SOC2 summary, network diagram, pilot SOW redline (attached), pricing-estimate.pdf, and a DocuSign link for the pilot SOW if we reach agreement.
- BetaCorp: procurement PO template (if you want us to prefill), list of must-have legal clauses, and confirmation of decision owner for final sign-off.

Attachments: pricing-estimate.pdf (same as earlier), redlines_draft.docx
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/XYZ123
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/h/record/BETA-2027-0422

If anything else should be added to the agenda please reply quickly — otherwise I’ll send the meeting notes and action owners within 2 hours after the call.

— Jasmine
